description: The Inbox: what tasks ask a person, the permission requests waiting and the sessions running, and an ask opened (Baude's and the Android app's).

messages.title: Inbox
messages.tip: What's waiting on you: tasks' asks and permission requests
messages.route_tip: Have a model answer, or send it to a Bot
messages.gone: This ask is no longer waiting
messages.bot_sent: This ask of Task “{$task}” (ask {$ask}, from {$bot}'s task) has been sent to you to answer. Answer it with your mcp__mesh__answer_ask tool: the ask's id, the button's index and the form's values.
messages.person_wrote: About your task “{$task}”'s ask (ask {$ask}), the person wrote:
messages.bot_may: You may propose an answer with your mcp__mesh__answer_ask tool (the ask's id, the button's index and the form's values): the person sees it and confirms it, and it doesn't answer the ask. Or put a new version of it with your mcp__mesh__revise_ask tool. Otherwise reply as you would.
messages.changed: That ask has changed: look at it again
messages.meta_prompt: Inbox: tasks ask the user things there (a deploy to approve, a choice to make), each ask a message with a form and the task's buttons. read_ask reads the ask the user has selected (its body, buttons, form and the values in it now, its task's run log and its Bot's chat); fill_ask fills its form for them to check. Pressing a button answers it: that's always the user's to do, never yours.
messages.read_ask_tool: The ask the user has selected in the Inbox (its tab, or the one last touched in the list): its body, buttons (by index), form fields and the values in them now, its task, the end of its run's log and of its Bot's chat.
messages.fill_ask_tool: Fill fields of the selected ask's form for the user to check: values \{field: value\}. It never presses a button (that answers the ask: the user's to do). Returns what didn't fit.
messages.model_prompt: A task asks a person the question below. Answer it for them: reply with only a JSON object with the keys button (the index of the button to press), values (the form's values, by each field's name) and why (a sentence saying why).
messages.not_waiting: That ask isn't waiting any more
messages.not_stopped: Only a stopped ask can be removed
messages.not_yours: That ask isn't of this run
messages.bad_picture: {$name}: not a picture this host can read
messages.bad_name: {$name}: a picture's name is letters, digits, . _ and -
messages.no_buttons: An ask needs at least one button
